$comment: The predefined runs of ./rr report: per scenario, per emitter, the sizes, seeds and options. A list in options measures every value as its own variant. Sizes and seeds live only here, per framework.

$bench.$comment: ./rr bench: one app per framework, at the largest size every framework builds in every scenario (beni-direct has no 128 or 256 in unique-components).

beni-direct.$comment: No 256: beni's ownership checker (its 64-path width cap) refuses the N=256 app on browser-direct, every seed; see frameworks/beni-direct/README.md.

marko.$comment: Only state=local (the default) is measured, here and in unique-components and big-component: the root-state variants cannot clear a number input's pending edit inside a tag, so a same-value write from the root leaves stale text (see frameworks/marko/README.md).

beni-direct.$comment: No 32, 128 or 256: beni's ownership checker (its 64-path width cap; every widget adds list paths to the one update summary) refuses the app with LIST MAY BE SHARED: N=32 for seed 3, N=96, 128 and 256 for every seed tried; see frameworks/beni-direct/README.md and notes/2026-10-16-beni-unique-components.md.

big-component.$comment: No digest: on the flat form it fails the prototype locality rule (calls per local action grow 8.6x from N=16 to 256, 14x from 64 to 1024), so it is excluded until fixed; see frameworks/digest/README.md (big-component) and notes/2026-10-16-big-component-digest-flat.md.

also.digest: fails the locality rule here (calls per local event grow 8.6x from N=16 to 256); timed for reference only

$bench.$comment: N=1 only: the js-framework-benchmark app, the calibration point (scenarios/big-table/README.md); growth with N is left to ./rr work.

beni-tea.$comment: Only N=1: from N=2 (seed 2) up, tables whose selection marker is aria-selected replace the selected <tr> instead of updating it, because the shipped vocabulary declares aria-* as a plain String, so beni cannot omit it (an upstream pub attribute "aria-selected" : Maybe String would fix it); that fails the node-identity rule, so those sizes do not count. N=1 (table 1 is js-framework-benchmark, marked by class) passes and is kept for the CPU bench. See notes/2026-10-16-beni-big-table.md.

beni-direct.$comment: Only N=1: from N=2 (seed 2) up, tables whose selection marker is aria-selected replace the selected <tr> instead of updating it, because the shipped vocabulary declares aria-* as a plain String, so beni cannot omit it (an upstream pub attribute "aria-selected" : Maybe String would fix it); that fails the node-identity rule, so those sizes do not count. N=1 (table 1 is js-framework-benchmark, marked by class) passes and is kept for the CPU bench. See notes/2026-10-16-beni-big-table.md. Its ownership checker also refuses N=16 and up.

$bench.$comment: ./rr bench: one app per framework at N=64, the size the dashboards bench at; p1 to p5 carry the actions (harness/bench/routed-app.js), the other pages exist only to be left unmounted.

beni-tea.$comment: Only N=1: from N=4 up the nav bar replaces the pinned buttons whose aria-current changes, because beni's shipped HTML vocabulary types aria-* as String (never removed); that fails the node-identity rule. Upstream fix: pub attribute "aria-current" : Maybe String. See notes/2026-10-17-routed-app-beni.md.

beni-direct.$comment: Only N=1: from N=4 up the nav bar replaces the pinned buttons whose aria-current changes, because beni's shipped HTML vocabulary types aria-* as String (never removed); that fails the node-identity rule. Upstream fix: pub attribute "aria-current" : Maybe String. See notes/2026-10-17-routed-app-beni.md.

derived-graph.$comment: No frameworks yet. An entry is expected to look like the others (sizes 1 to 256, seeds 1 to 3) plus "options": { "fanout": ["low", "mid", "high"] }, which measures each readers-per-value level as its own variant (solid, solid-fanout=low, solid-fanout=high); see scenarios/derived-graph/README.md. No digest: the sheet is one model and a flat binding list re-runs all of it, so it fails the prototype locality rule (calls per local action grow 17x from N=16 to 256, rows fixed); it is excluded until fixed, see frameworks/digest/README.md (derived-graph).

$bench.$comment: N=64 with the default 2,000 items: the dashboards' bench size; the work actions as do/undo pairs (harness/bench/derived-graph.js).

also.digest: fails the locality rule here (calls per local event grow 17x from N=16 to 256); timed for reference only

beni-direct.$comment: Sizes 1 to 128 only: browser-direct's compiler memory and time grow steeply with N on this app (every handler re-runs the whole derived block, so the JavaScript grows about with N squared: 368 kB at N=64, 1.16 MB at 128): 3.9 GB and 39 s at N=128, 8.1 GB and 83 s at N=160, and the build is killed (SIGTERM, no diagnostic) past 12 GB at N=192 and 256. See notes/2026-10-17-beni-derived-graph.md.
